newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's buys Hardee's units; expands Tim Hortons chain.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's buys Hardee's units; expands Tim Hortons chain.

text.p: Wendy's International Inc. said Tuesday it agreed to buy 45 Detroit-area Hardee's restaurants with plans to convert 35 of them into the Tim Hortons coffee-and-breakfast-pastry format.
The move would mark the first major U.S. expansion of the Tim Hortons format, the company said. Wendy's acquired the Canadian chain last year.

Wendy's said it would buy the restaurants for an undisclosed amount of cash from Hardee's Food Systems Inc., a wholly-owned unit of Montreal-based Imasco Ltd. The outlets are company owned, not franchises.
Wendy's Tim Hortons unit has more than 1,300 company-owned and franchised restaurants, open 24 hours but with peak sales in the morning, Wendy's said.
The move is consistent with Wendy's strategic growth plan. Wendy's last year bought 40 former Roy Rogers restaurants in the New York metropolitan area.
Ten of the acquired Hardee's units will become Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburger restaurants.
